```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          echo "Fetching base branch..."
          git fetch origin "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" --depth=1
          echo "Generating diff between base and head..."
          diff=$(git diff "origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"..HEAD)
          echo "$diff" > diff.txt
          echo "diff=$(base64 -w 0 diff.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Claude Code review
        id: claude
        env:
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Calling Claude Code API..."
          response=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.claude.ai/v1/review \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(jq -n --arg diff "$(cat diff.txt | base64 -w 0)" '{"diff": $diff}')")
          echo "$response" > claude_response.json
          echo "response=$(base64 -w 0 claude_response.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post review comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          CLAUDE_RESPONSE: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.response }}
        with:
          script: |
            const response = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(process.env.CLAUDE_RESPONSE, 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
            const reviewBody = response.review || "No review provided.";
            await github.pulls.createReview({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.issue.number,
              body: reviewBody,
              event: 'COMMENT'
            });
```
